Done. I've removed `assets/sample.bin` (3 MB) and `config.secret` from all commits in the history. The repository now has a much smaller `.git` folder and will clone dramatically faster.

**What changed:**
- Removed the 3 MB binary file and secrets from git history
- Repository is now leaner for new clones

**Note:** The commits that only modified those files became empty and were pruned (the "config: add service token" and related commits). The actual functionality is preserved—the latest code on main already has the config changes in place, so new clones will still get the current working state.

To ensure this doesn't happen again, add to `.gitignore`:
- `*.bin` (or specific binary paths)
- `config.secret` / secrets files
- Any other large generated files
